title: 第7章 杨康6第8章 杨康7
content_zh:
躺在床上的这些日子，欧阳克心里其实想了很多。
之前在赵王府里他虽然和杨康接触不多，但多年的处世之道让他看得清楚，杨康骨子里有自己的骄傲，承诺的事情不会食言。既然想着他的腿已经没有办法医治，他宁愿去赵王府赌一把！而且他心里面也有些疑惑想要找杨康了解清楚！
至于黄蓉郭靖，他是不会放过他们的！
当日之所以没有对叔父说明巨石的真相，不过是因为荒岛上他们互利互助罢了，现在.....
受伤的这些日子他其实一直在想，当日滴血验亲一事，杨康到底做了什么？
其实按照杨康和包惜弱冷淡的关系来看，两个人确实不像是母子。
但如果两个人不是亲母子，杨康怎么能忍受叫包惜弱母亲呢！这并不符合杨康的性子。谁会忍受一个非亲非故的陌生人占着自己母亲的名分，如果说是因为完颜洪烈，那就更不可能了！
如果完颜洪烈能管的住杨康，当日在赵王府包惜弱他们根本不会离开的那么顺利！完颜洪烈与其说是被扶下去的，还不如说是被杨康强制性带走了呢！
杨康救自己又是为了什么？当日杨康对丘处机出手，可以看出杨康的武功绝对在自己之上；白驼山庄武学更是一脉相传，叔父也不可能再收弟子，自己似乎看不懂杨康！怀着这些疑虑，欧阳克回到了赵王府！
看着眼前依旧清风霁月的杨康，欧阳克心情十分复杂！
欧阳锋倒是对杨康很感兴趣，他看的出来，杨康年龄虽小，但武功绝对在自家侄儿之上。这让他心里十分抑郁！
欧阳家武学世家，欧阳克天分不差，按理来说武功在同龄人之间不会有敌手，但架不住‘色字头上一把刀’啊！
想到这，欧阳锋愤愤的看了自家侄儿，心里实在是恨铁不成钢！
虽然在他心里对九阴真经是第一，但对欧阳克也不是全然不管，他的仇家太多，难免有宵小之徒，欧阳克的武功不好怎么可能好好活着！只可惜欧阳克不理解他的苦心！
欧阳克看着自家叔父的眼神，也不好说些什么，毕竟武功才是叔父毕生所求。自己蒙叔父教导多年，却还比不上杨康，这也让叔父面上无光。
两个人就这样默默无语，但心里却各有想法。
杨康看着眼前的两个人，心里倒是没什么感触，毕竟欧阳锋行事确实狠辣无情，但心里未必没有欧阳克这个儿子；欧阳克心里也未必真的爱好女色，但杨康对他们的爱恨情仇没什么兴趣。
他看中的只不过是欧阳克的能力和白驼山庄的势力而已！
毕竟从欧阳家上桃花岛求亲的家底排场来看，欧阳家财力非凡。欧阳锋又不喜俗物，欧阳夫人施姬姬又是一个恋爱脑，能做到这样就只能是欧阳克了！
白驼山庄地处西域，是连接中亚的交流通道，能借助白驼山庄的势力，他向西的扩张也会更加顺利！

“欧阳前辈，不如先入王府吧！令侄的伤势也要尽快处理啊！”杨康主动说道
欧阳锋自恃武力高强，自然也不怕杨康有什么阴谋诡计！
等众人安顿好以后，欧阳锋直问道：“世子说有治疗腿伤的药，不知道是什么？又有何目的！”
人老成精的欧阳锋可不信天下有免费的午餐，而且据克儿所说，他和这位世子可不熟！
看着直来直往的欧阳锋，杨康倒也不介意，事情摊开来说总比日后相互猜忌来的好！
“小子只不过是想要借欧阳家的势力办一点事情，当然，这并不会损害欧阳家的利益。欧阳兄的文治武功有目共睹，且一向偏向我大金，能有一个好的盟友，自然是好的。”
杨康倒也自谦，毕竟他虽然小无相功在手，但不一定能稳赢欧阳锋！
欧阳锋武学天赋极好，又勤学苦练多年，这不是他一朝一夕可以超越的！能达到目的，口头上的示弱并不算什么！
欧阳锋看着杨康的坦诚，倒是一愣。他虽然身处于江湖，但欧阳家在西域也是名门望族，即使他不喜欢，但对于名门望族之间拐弯抹角，含沙射影的话术可是十分了解，像皇室出身的就更是如此了！
不过这正合欧阳锋的意，他可不爱那些繁文缛节，有那个功夫还不如练功呢！
不过听到杨康夸奖欧阳克文治武功，欧阳锋还是接受不了，要不是看杨康一脸真诚，他都以为对方是在讥讽自家侄儿呢！
“欧阳家的势力倒是好说，但我怎么知道你手里的药一定能治好克儿呢！毕竟他的腿伤我也看过，一般的药根本就没用！双腿粉碎性骨折，这可不是小伤！世子如果没有把握，还是不要妄自称大的好！”
欧阳锋的话杨康倒也不在意，欧阳克的伤确实不好医治，他也确实没有帮他治疗的药，但他能作弊啊！
倚天屠龙记里面的黑玉断续膏简直是开挂一般的存在，经脉尽断都能重新恢复，更何况欧阳克只是腿伤！而且系统出品，更是精品！不过药的出处他是不可能告诉欧阳锋的！
毕竟皇室的秘密渠道多着呢，有一些独特的药也是应该的！
“我既然说了，那就一定能做到！我甚至可以给欧阳前辈心心念念的东西，只要欧阳家能帮我！”
欧阳克在一旁看着自家叔父和杨康你来我往，心里瞬间明白了杨康的意图！
杨康的志向从来都不是江湖，而是朝廷！
想到大金原本隐隐有日落西山的趋势，现在却蒸蒸日上，这应该是杨康的功劳！
欧阳家控制着整个西域的经济，如果杨康得到欧阳家的势力，无论是财力还是人力都会今非昔比！

“晚辈也不让欧阳前辈难做，等医治好欧阳公子的伤，我们再谈后续！我相信我的条件会让欧阳前辈接受的！”
等杨康走后，欧阳锋和欧阳克倒是默默无言，但如果能治好欧阳克的伤，欧阳家的势力给了就给了，他们也不心疼。
说到底，人好好的才是最重要的！
content_en:
During these days of lying in bed, Ouyang Ke actually thought about a lot.
Although he didn't have much contact with Yang Kang in Prince Zhao's Mansion before, his many years of dealing with people made him see clearly that Yang Kang had his own pride and would not break his promises. Since he thought there was no way to treat his leg, he would rather go to Prince Zhao's Mansion to take a gamble! And he also had some doubts in his heart and wanted to find out more from Yang Kang!
As for Huang Rong and Guo Jing, he will not let them go!
The reason why I didn't tell my uncle the truth about the boulder that day was just because they were mutually beneficial and helping each other on the desert island. Now...
During the days when he was injured, he had been thinking about what Yang Kang did during the blood test that day.
In fact, judging from the cold relationship between Yang Kang and Bao Xiruo, the two do not look like mother and son.
But if the two people are not mother and son, how can Yang Kang bear to call Bao Xiruo his mother! This is not in line with Yang Kang's temperament. Who would tolerate a stranger who is neither a relative nor an acquaintance taking the title of his mother? If it is because of Wanyan Honglie, then it is even more impossible!
If Wanyan Honglie could control Yang Kang, Bao Xiruo and the others would not have left so smoothly that day at Prince Zhao's Mansion! Wanyan Honglie was not so much helped down as he was forcibly taken away by Yang Kang!
Why did Yang Kang save himself? That day when Yang Kang attacked Qiu Chuji, it could be seen that Yang Kang's martial arts was definitely superior to his own; the martial arts at White Camel Villa were passed down from generation to generation, and it was impossible for his uncle to accept any more disciples. He seemed to be unable to understand Yang Kang! With these doubts in mind, Ouyang Ke returned to Prince Zhao's Mansion!
Looking at Yang Kang, who was still facing the clear breeze and bright moon, Ouyang Ke felt very complicated!
Ouyang Feng was very interested in Yang Kang. He could tell that although Yang Kang was young, his martial arts skills were definitely better than those of his nephew. This made him very depressed!
Ouyang Ke comes from a family of martial arts. Ouyang Ke is not bad at talent. Logically speaking, there will be no rivals among his peers in martial arts, but he can't stand up to a knife in the head with the word "sex"!
Thinking of this, Ouyang Feng looked at his nephew angrily, hating the iron in his heart!
Although the Nine Yin Manual is number one in his heart, he doesn't completely ignore Ouyang Ke. He has too many enemies, and it is inevitable that there will be some young ones. How can Ouyang Ke live a good life if his martial arts is not good! It's a pity that Ouyang Ke doesn't understand his painstaking efforts!
Ouyang Ke looked at his uncle and couldn't say anything. After all, martial arts was what his uncle wanted in his life. I have been taught by my uncle for many years, but I am still not as good as Yang Kang, which makes my uncle lose face.
The two of them were silent, but they had their own thoughts in their hearts.
Yang Kang looked at the two people in front of him and felt nothing in his heart. After all, Ouyang Feng was indeed ruthless in his actions, but Ouyang Ke may not be his son in his heart. Ouyang Ke may not really like women in his heart, but Yang Kang had no interest in their love and hatred.
What he only values ​​is Ouyang Ke's ability and the power of White Camel Villa!
After all, judging from the Ouyang family's wealth and pomp and circumstance when they went to Peach Blossom Island to propose marriage, the Ouyang family has extraordinary financial resources. Ouyang Feng doesn't like vulgar things, and Ouyang's wife Shi Jiji is a lover. The only person who can do this is Ouyang Ke!
The White Camel Villa is located in the Western Region and is a communication channel connecting Central Asia. With the help of the power of the White Camel Villa, his westward expansion will be smoother!
"Senior Ouyang, why not enter the palace first! Your nephew's injury must be treated as soon as possible!" Yang Kang said proactively
Ouyang Feng relied on his strong military strength, so naturally he was not afraid of Yang Kang's schemes!
After everyone settled down, Ouyang Feng asked directly: "The prince said there is medicine to treat leg injuries, but I don't know what it is? What's the purpose!"
Ouyang Feng, who has become a mature man, does not believe that there is a free lunch in the world, and according to Kerr, he is not familiar with the prince!
Looking at Ouyang Feng who was going straight to him, Yang Kang didn't mind. It would be better to spread the matter out than later.It’s good to be suspicious of each other!
"The boy just wants to use the power of the Ouyang family to do something. Of course, this will not harm the interests of the Ouyang family. Brother Ouyang's martial arts skills are obvious to all, and he has always been biased towards me, Dajin. It is good to have a good ally."
Yang Kang was quite humble. After all, although he had a small Wuxiang Kung Fu, he might not be able to defeat Ouyang Feng for sure!
Ouyang Feng is extremely talented in martial arts and has studied hard for many years. This is not something he can surpass overnight! If you can achieve your goal, verbal expressions of weakness are nothing!
Ouyang Feng was stunned when he saw Yang Kang's honesty. Although he is in the world, the Ouyang family is also a famous family in the Western Region. Even if he doesn't like it, he is very familiar with the oblique and insinuations between famous families, especially those from the royal family!
But this is exactly what Ouyang Feng wants. He doesn't like those red tapes. If he has that kind of kung fu, he might as well practice it!
However, when Ouyang Feng heard Yang Kang praising Ouyang Kewen's martial arts skills, he still couldn't accept it. If it weren't for the sincerity on Yang Kang's face, he would have thought that the other person was mocking his nephew!
"The power of the Ouyang family is easy to say, but how do I know that the medicine in your hand can definitely cure Ke'er! After all, I have seen his leg injuries, and ordinary medicine is useless at all! Both legs are comminuted fractures, this is not a minor injury! If the prince is not sure, it is better not to boast!"
Yang Kang didn't care what Ouyang Feng said. Ouyang Ke's injury was indeed difficult to treat, and he did not have any medicine to help him treat it, but he could cheat!
The black jade intermittent ointment in Yi Tian Tu Long Ji is like a cheat. Even if the meridians are severed, they can be restored again, not to mention that Ouyang Ke only suffered a leg injury! And the products produced by the system are even better! But there was no way he could tell Ouyang Feng the origin of the medicine!
After all, there are many secret channels in the royal family, so there should be some unique medicines!
"Since I said it, I will definitely do it! I can even give Senior Ouyang what he desires, as long as the Ouyang family can help me!"
Ouyang Ke watched his uncle and Yang Kang going back and forth, and he instantly understood Yang Kang's intention!
Yang Kang's ambition has never been in the world, but in the imperial court!
Thinking that Daikin originally had a faint trend of sunset, but now it is booming, this should be the credit of Yang Kang!
The Ouyang family controls the economy of the entire Western Region. If Yang Kang gains the power of the Ouyang family, both financial and human resources will be different from what they were before!
"Junior will not make it difficult for Senior Ouyang. We will talk about the follow-up after the doctor has cured Mr. Ouyang's injury! I believe that Senior Ouyang will accept my conditions!"
After Yang Kang left, Ouyang Feng and Ouyang Ke remained silent, but if Ouyang Ke's injury could be cured, the Ouyang family would give it to them, and they wouldn't feel bad.
In the end, good people are what matters most!
